# Experterna om Anthropics IPO – Yubicos vd om AI-hotet

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode centres on Anthropic's IPO day (valuation of about USD 1,500bn) and on cybersecurity. Yubico's CEO and Tin Fonder's Carl Armfelt make the case that cybersecurity will be a board-level priority in 2027. Armfelt is cautious on the Anthropic IPO in the short term: he points to API revenue that customers can easily move elsewhere, slowing growth and an aggressive retail-driven price. VNV Global's CEO discusses its asset sales, buybacks, the ~50% discount to net asset value and a possible Voi IPO. NCAB and NKT CEOs present their new targets and investment plans, and the Stockholm market is risk-on.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 YUBICO — Yubico | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Tin added in May on the thesis that cybersecurity is a board-level issue in 2027. Q3 order intake +88%. Valuation reasonable compared with US peers.

#### Reasoning

Guest Carl Armfelt (Tin Fonder) holds a large position and added in May. AI-driven attacks are speeding up demand: order intake grew 88% in Q3. Yubico is priced slightly above the average small cap but well below US peers such as Palo Alto. Key items to watch are the software strategy presented at the CMD and whether revenue and profit keep pace with orders.

#### Sell Triggers

- if revenue and earnings fail to follow order acceleration
- if cybersecurity falls off the 2027 agenda
- if the CMD shows no credible software strategy

> *"Men värderingen är fortfarande rimlig om man tror att cybersäkerhet kommer att vara ett fokusområde 2027."*

---

### 🟢 HEM — Hemnet | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Per Brilioth believes Hemnet will turn around: it is one of the strongest marketplaces in the world and has a skilled ownership base.

#### Reasoning

Guest Per Brilioth (VNV CEO) has a track record in marketplaces such as Avito. He says that, if well run, Hemnet will absolutely turn around despite new competition and recent share weakness. This is a stated view, not a stated position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if competition erodes market share
- if management mismanages pricing

> *"Det har kommit lite konkurrens men rätt skött tror jag absolut att det kommer att vända."*

---

### 🟠 NCAB — NCAB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

New targets of 15% growth and EBITA margin above 15%. Q3 growth 50%, underlying order intake +20-25%. Price effects are expected to fade.

#### Reasoning

Per the company's own CEO, growth is strong but partly driven by AI supply-chain price effects that will partly fade. The previous targets were missed. Shares are up 60% this year, so the question is whether the new targets can be met.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price effect fades faster than expected
- if new targets are missed like previous ones

> *"Framåt ser vi att den här effekten kommer delvis att avta, men vi ser ändå att vi över den här tiden framåt kommer att kunna ha en god tillväxt i det här häradet 15 procent."*

---

### 🟢 TRUE-B — Truecaller | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Analyst view: ABG upgrades to buy from hold and raises its target to SEK 35 from 23. Shares up nearly 5%.

#### Reasoning

This is cited analyst opinion (ABG), not host or guest opinion. The upgrade comes with a target price raised by about 50%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price reaches the SEK 35 target
- if ABG reverses its recommendation

> *"ABG höjer rekommendationen för Truecaller till köp från behåll och riktkursen höjs till 35 kronor från 23."*

---

### 🟠 NKT — NKT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Negative organic growth and heavy capex are weighing on cash flow. Growth should return from Q2 2026 when the Karlskrona plant starts operating. Cash flow should improve sharply in 2028-29.

#### Reasoning

Per the company's own CEO, Q3 was in line with expectations. The EUR 2bn investment phase ends next year, after which revenue should grow and capex fall. Power-grid demand from AI and electrification is a structural tailwind.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Karlskrona ramp-up is delayed
- if organic growth does not return in 2027

> *"Intäkterna kommer öka, investeringarna kommer gå ner, vilket under 2028-2029 också kommer ha ett kraftigt påverkan på vårt kassaflöde."*

---

### 🟠 PDX — Paradox Interactive | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Armfelt names Paradox, Take-Two and Nintendo as gaming companies to keep an eye on.

#### Reasoning

Guest Carl Armfelt describes Paradox as one of the best-run companies in gaming. No position was stated.

> *"Nintendo, Take-Two och Paradox tycker jag är bolag man ska hålla koll på i sektorn."*

---

### 🟠 TTWO — Take-Two Interactive | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

GTA 6 launched with strong reviews. Management is impressive. Tin is a former shareholder.

#### Reasoning

Guest Armfelt: one of the best-run companies in the sector, and GTA 6 could recoup its development cost in the first week. Tin no longer holds the stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- if GTA 6 sales disappoint

> *"Nintendo, Take-Two och Paradox tycker jag är bolag man ska hålla koll på i sektorn."*

---

### 🟠 VNV — VNV Global | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Trades at about a 50% discount to NAV. Selling assets slightly above book value and buying back shares. A Voi IPO next year could narrow the discount.

#### Reasoning

View from the company's own CEO, so not independent. Asset sales above book value plus buybacks at a 50% discount add value, and a Voi listing would make the portfolio easier to value.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Voi IPO does not happen
- if portfolio markdowns continue

> *"För min del, för VNV, vore det väldigt bra med en börsnotering."*
